entities.name: František Černík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: František Černík is a Czech former ice hockey player who represented Czechoslovakia. Most of his career was spent in the Czechoslovak First Ice Hockey League with TJ Vítkovice, where he played from 1978 to 1984. He played for the Czechoslovakia All-Stars that played all eight World Hockey Association teams for one game apiece in December 1977 of the 1977–78 WHA season. He scored four goals and three assists in the eight games.
